title: feat(spec): register the invitation role cap refusal codes under plugin-auth
body:
Fixes #24082
Clause-②: yes (widening)

## What

Registers three `@objectstack/plugin-auth` codes in `packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts`, one per refusal the invitation role cap (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/invitation-role-cap.ts`) can return. Today `auth-manager.ts` throws all three as a bare `APIError('FORBIDDEN', { message })` from `beforeCreateInvitation` (`:3416`–`:3423`), so the Invite User dialog cannot branch on them.

| Code | Producer path at `8a83cebc15` | Status `plugin-auth` pairs it with |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `INVITE_ROLE_ABOVE_ISSUER` | `invitation-role-cap.ts:186`–`192`: the requested role grades above the issuer's own | 403 |
| `INVITE_ISSUER_MEMBER_ONLY` | `invitation-role-cap.ts:194`–`199`: an issuer below admin grade asks for anything but a single plain `member` | 403 |
| `INVITE_ISSUER_UNVERIFIED` | `invitation-role-cap.ts:175`–`181`: the issuer's grade is unresolved (`resolveMembershipRole` answered `null`) | 403, fail-closed |

Registration only, ahead of the producer (the `FLOW_INPUT_SCHEMA_INVALID` split shape the ledger test already records). #23945 stamps these codes in `plugin-auth`; that card is not closed by this PR.

## Measurements

- **The set is exactly three.** `invitationRoleCapFailure` has three non-null returns (lines 175, 186, 194) and no other refusal; its one caller (`auth-manager.ts:3416`) turns each into the same `FORBIDDEN`. Path 2 is reached only by an issuer below admin grade: an admin or owner passes `grantTableAdmits` for every role except one that outranks them, which is path 1.
- **Names under the synonym gate.** `standardSynonymOf` on the built `dist` returns `undefined` for all three (`INVITE` is a token no standard member carries), and `ErrorCode.safeParse` accepts each. No `STANDARD_SYNONYM_WAIVERS` entry. Named in the existing `INVITE_*` family, for the condition rather than the status.
- **Condition 3 is fail-closed, and its comment says so.** `resolveMembershipRole` (`auth-manager.ts:7612`) answers `null` for four inputs: missing keys, no engine, no membership row, or a lookup that threw. The cap cannot tell them apart, so the code's meaning is "could not be established" and it pairs with 403, fail-closed. Whether #23945 should split the thrown-lookup case onto the standard `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` (as the slug guard's read fault does, `auth-manager.ts:1333`) is noted below for that card. It is not decided here.

## Files

- `packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts`: three rows, each with a meaning comment citing #24082.
- `packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.test.ts`: one case pinning the three by value (parse, owner, no synonym), mirroring the registered-ahead-of-producer precedent.
- `content/docs/references/api/contract.mdx`, `content/docs/references/api/error-code-ledger.mdx`: regenerated by `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated --fix` (the only stale artifact it found was `check:docs`).
- `.changeset/24082-invite-role-cap-codes.md`: `minor` on `@objectstack/spec`.

## Verification (head `44818e2e6d`)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`: exit 0. Then `exec vitest run src/api/error-code-ledger.test.ts src/api/api-error-code-type.test.ts`: 2 files, 24 tests passed. `typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: exit 1 before regeneration (`check:docs` stale), exit 0 after `--fix`.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 111 families derived, all run and reconciled with `--ran` (`111 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 109 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED`). Among them `check:error-code-casing`, `check:dispatcher-error-vocabulary`, `check:error-code-provenance`, `check:api-surface` and `check:docs` all exit 0.
- NOT MEASURED locally: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:lean-entry-closure` (exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET: they need a whole-workspace build). Both are left to CI's `Lint & Repo Gates`.
- ESLint (`--no-inline-config`) over both changed `.ts` files: exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- For #23945 (not a finding filed): `resolveMembershipRole` answers `null` both when the issuer has no membership row and when the lookup threw. Under this registration both are `INVITE_ISSUER_UNVERIFIED` with 403. If #23945 separates the thrown lookup, the existing standard `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` is the code that fits it, so no fourth code is registered here.
